notes: Net-new stories created for token lifecycle. No reuse of duplicate story IDs.

change_log.value: Integration with GPTReader and Azure Functions auth

stories.title: Define Token Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the bearer token structure including fields for token_id, subject, scopes, issued_at, expires_at, rotation_version, and revocation status. Establish validation rules and serialization contract aligned with existing auth.py usage.

stories.title: Implement Core Token Lifecycle Logic
stories.description: Implement issuance, rotation, expiration, and revocation logic. Ensure tokens expire based on TTL, support rotation with versioning, and enforce revocation checks during validation.

stories.title: Token Validation Enforcement Middleware
stories.description: Implement middleware or request interceptor to validate bearer tokens on incoming requests. Enforce expiration, scope checks, and revocation before allowing access to protected services.

stories.title: Token Lifecycle Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering token issuance, expiration, rotation, revocation, and validation enforcement. Include edge cases such as expired tokens, invalid signatures, and revoked tokens.

stories.title: Integrate Token Lifecycle with GPTReader and Azure Functions
stories.description: Integrate lifecycle enforcement into GPTReader and Azure Functions entry points to ensure all data access paths require valid bearer tokens and respect lifecycle rules.

per_feature.mitigation: Reuse existing auth.py validation patterns and limit scope to enforcement without introducing new auth providers
